The minimum hourly wage in Massachusetts is currently $15.00 per hour for non-tipped employees, as confirmed by multiple official sources [d1][d6][d5][d9]. This rate has been in effect since January 1, 2023, and there are no scheduled increases on the books [d8][d4]. For tipped employees, employers may pay a base rate of $6.75 per hour, provided that wages plus tips together equal at least $15.00 per hour — otherwise the employer must make up the difference [d3][d6][d4]. Additionally, farm workers who are year-round Massachusetts residents are subject to a lower rate of $8.00 per hour, though farm workers with federal visas are entitled to a federal prevailing wage above $16.00 per hour [d8].
